records.structural_reconciliation: Independent pyridine-N-first traversal places pyridine N1, retainedCl at C2 and aryloxy at C4. On the phenol-derived ring,amine is para to O and F is meta to O/ortho to amine. This is3-fluoro4-aminophenol,notA26's2-fluoro4-aminophenol. Product and both essential source substrates reconcile exactly to the frozen complete reaction key. No stereo,isotope,salt or protecting-group normalization was applied.
